item.title: Bondi Beach Lifeguards Were First on the Scene of Mass Shooting, Saved Lives Under Gunfire
item.description: As reports emerge from the tragic mass shooting at Bondi Beach in Australia, people on the ground say that lifeguards were the first to respond.

item.title: WSL Takes Legal Action Against Pedro Scooby for Criticizing Judges at Saquarema Event
item.description: A day after big-wave surfer Pedro Scooby competed in the Nazaré Big Wave Challenge, news broke that the WSL is filing legal proceedings against him in Brazil.

item.title: A Deceased Hiker’s Smartwatch Helped Authorities Piece Together a Bear Attack
item.description: The smartwatch of a man who was fatally attacked by a brown bear on the Japanese island of Hokkaido sadly contains clues to the final minutes of his life.

item.title: Hawaii Spearfisherman Gets Bitten by Shark, Calls Mother, Takes Bong Rip
item.description: Kaimani Ventura, 24, had a horrific encounter with a shark while diving off the Big Island, as he recounts in an Instagram video describing the ordeal.

item.title: Snowboarder Films a Bear Chasing Him During an Early Morning Run in Japan
item.description: Japan is experiencing a wave of bear attacks on humans, with 13 fatal attacks across the country since April. Footage shows a bear chasing a snowboarder.

item.title: John John Florence Came Out With Guns Blazing at the Pipe Pro
item.description: John John Florence is synonymous with Pipeline. He grew up with the world's most famous wave as his playground, and it was obvious at the Florence Pipe Pro.

item.title: In Praise of Surf Localism
item.description: Following a violent clash in Tenerife, many online commentators opined about the glory days of surf localism. Sam George takes a look at the odd trend.

item.title: Billionaire Buys Steamboat Springs Apartment Complex and Turns It Into Affordable Housing
item.description: In the face of rising housing costs, a billionaire purchased an apartment building in Steamboat Springs, Colorado and turned it into affordable housing.

item.title: Indonesia Is Full of Waves, But This Might Be the Most Underrated of Them All
item.description: Indonesia is full of amazing waves. Famous ones like Uluwatu, Lance's Right, and. Bingin There are plenty of not-so-famous waves that often fly under the radar.

item.title: A New Plastic Is Here, and It Biodegrades In Salt Water in Just a Few Hours
item.description: Researchers have made a leap in the fight against plastic pollution. A new material created from cellulose could be the beginnings of something amazing.
